text:
trevor: Hey @maria @sara — two quick reimbursement questions from last week's Berlin trip:

1) Corpcard charge 347.12 EUR posted as $360.50 on the statement (FX + possible merchant markup). Do we reimburse at the original EUR amount or the USD-posted amount?
2) Hotel folio is a single PDF (no VAT line for breakfast). Can we approve with manager attestation for EU tax purposes?
Also asking for a per-diem override: had a 10-hr layover that required an extra meal; requesting partial per-diem for that day. Receipts uploaded to Expensify (expense id 2026-8423).

expense-bot: Expense 2026-8423 submitted by trevor — status: awaiting documentation. Link: https://expensify.com/report/2026-8423

maria: Thanks Trevor. Can you paste the card txn line (date and posted USD amount) and the hotel folio filename so I can route to VAT team? Also cc your manager for per-diem signoff.

trevor: Sure — posting the txn here:
```
Card txn: 2026-03-15 | Merchant: AIRLINE X | Amount: 347.12 EUR | Posted: 2026-03-17 | USD posted: $360.50 | Auth code: ABC123DEF
Hotel folio: 'GrandBerlin_Folio_1410.pdf' (uploaded)
Per-diem request: 2026-03-16 partial day, extra meal $18.30
```

aj: For the FX markup — finance policy A.4 says we reimburse the USD posted amount by default to avoid reconciliation gaps. You can still open a dispute for the extra FX fee with the card provider if it looks like merchant markup. Steps: 1) submit card dispute via portal, 2) attach merchant receipt and payment posting, 3) let finance know if dispute is resolved so we can adjust reimburse.

sara: I can sign off on the per-diem override. @maria please accept manager attestation for Trevor's extra meal.

maria: Got it. I'll temporarily approve the hotel folio with a manager attestation for VAT purposes so treasury can proceed. Please do the dispute for the FX fee (aj's steps). I need the boarding pass or e-ticket to confirm the fare class (helps VAT team). If you can attach here I’ll mark the expense approved for payment.

trevor: Thanks all — attaching boarding pass screenshot now and I'll start the dispute with bank. :thumbsup:

maria: Received. I'll mark expense 'approved - pending dispute outcome' and update the ticket. Policy ref: https://redwood.example.com/finance/expenses#fx-and-vat

expense-bot: Expense 2026-8423 status updated to 'approved (pending dispute)'.
